message:
Prime Tower Sorter: Sort all Rust code into 71-level tower

🗼 Complete sorting by complexity mod 71

Features:
✓ Analyzes all Rust files with syn
✓ Calculates complexity: lines + 10*fns + 5*structs + 3*enums
✓ Sorts into 71 levels (0-70)
✓ Each level mapped to Monster prime
✓ Saves to disk: prime_tower/level_XX_prime_YY/
✓ Generates metadata.json per level
✓ Visual tower display
✓ Statistics report

Test Results (54 files):
- Total complexity: 55,428
- Occupied levels: 38/71
- Avg complexity: 1,026
- Most complex: 37,993 (level 8, prime 23)

Top Levels:
1. Level 16 (prime 3): 3 files, avg 110
2. Level 49 (prime 11): 3 files, avg 191
3. Level 6 (prime 17): 3 files, avg 148
4. Level 70 (prime 31): 3 files, avg 164
5. Level 54 (prime 29): 2 files, avg 693

Tower Structure:
  Level 70 (prime 31): 3 files █
  Level 69 (prime 29): 1 files █
  ...
  Level 0 (prime 2): 1 files █

Output:
  prime_tower/
    level_00_prime_02/
      metadata.json
      0000_file.rs
    level_01_prime_03/
    ...
    tower_summary.json

Usage:
  cargo build --release --bin prime_tower_sorter
  ./target/release/prime_tower_sorter /path/to/code

Integration:
  unified_monster_system → prime_tower_sorter →
  71 levels → parquet shards → qwen shards

Status: ✅ Production-ready tower sorting!
